BiblicalUsage: This word means lively or vigorous, and the midwives use it of the Hebrew women, who are lively and delivered before the midwives come. The liveliness of the mothers is the excuse that saves the babies.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God used the strength of the mothers to defeat Pharaoh's order, and the midwives' plain words hid His deliverance in plain sight.
